name: Grade 10 Chemistry: The Periodic Table
subject: Chemistry
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to describe the arrangement of elements in the periodic table
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to relate electron configuration to group and period
learningActivities: Discussion: learners recall elements they know
Chart work: teacher explains groups and periods using a periodic table chart
Group work: learners locate given elements on the periodic table
Application: learners write electronic configurations and state group and period
keyPoints: Elements are arranged in order of increasing atomic number
Vertical columns are called groups and horizontal rows are called periods
The group number relates to the number of outer electrons
commonMisconceptions: Confusing atomic number with mass number
lessonEvaluation: Learners locate elements and write their electronic configurations. Teacher checks work.
teacherReflection: Good progress. More practice on electronic configuration needed.
